metadata.description: Parth Suri's collection of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: shoe-shopping-analyzer
plugins.description: Compare shoes across every available shopping site with deep filtering on price, fit, size/width, activity, performance specs, and reviews. Live web research + structured scraping + weighted ranking.

plugins.name: pg-finder
plugins.description: Find and rank PG (paying guest) accommodation in any city — a maps-based 5 km search around your office/college (or the clustered midpoint for a group of 2-3), with gender, budget, AC/non-AC, sharing, food, and amenity filters. Free OpenStreetMap geocoding, live listing research, weighted ranking, and an interactive HTML map.

plugins.name: song-finder
plugins.description: Find songs and build playlists from singers (primary), mood, language, genre, and era — plus similar-artist discoveries matched to your taste. Every track verified against the key-less iTunes catalog (real metadata + 30-sec previews); similar artists from MusicBrainz + ListenBrainz listener data; output as an interactive HTML playlist with YouTube/Spotify/JioSaavn links.
